<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks a nitro group (functional_groups_broken=["nitro"]) without specifying formed groups, using a simple nitro‑benzene SMILES as the target. Increase the result limit to 50 to capture more possible templates, hoping to find one where the reactant contains a nitro group and the product contains an amine (nitro‑to‑amine reduction).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "limit": 50
}</action_input>
